story.originalTitle: Five things to look out for at the F1 Dutch GP
story.summaryEn: Formula 1 returns from its 2026 summer shutdown this weekend with the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort, which marks the halfway point of the season. The race promises championship battles and the fight for seats on next season's grid.
detailZh: F1荷兰大奖赛值得关注的五件事
本周末F1将在赞德沃特举行比赛，从夏季休整期回归
本周末的荷兰大奖赛标志着一级方程式从2026年夏季休整期回归，赛季尾声已近在眼前。
赞德沃特是本赛季的中点，休整期后将有总冠军之争、传奇的书写，以及下赛季车手席位的争夺成败。
所以这个周末有很多值得期待的看点，以下是需要留意的五件事。
看起来已经没有什么能阻止19岁的安东内利在2026年成为史上最年轻的F1世界冠军了。这位梅赛德斯车手目前领先第二名汉密尔顿50分，而且在暑假之后，还从来没有哪位积分榜领跑者挥霍过如此巨大的优势。
这肯定不是赛季开始前人们所预料的，当时安东内利的队友拉塞尔才是夺冠的大热门，但自从第二站中国站以来，这位意大利车手就一直技高一筹。
安东内利状态出色的关键在于他的单圈速度，本赛季他已经拿到六个杆位，而且每次这位第二个赛季征战的车手遭遇挫折时，他都能以一种冠军般的方式强势反弹。
想想比利时站吧，尽管在此前三场比赛中的两场——巴塞罗那和银石——因可靠性问题未能得分，安东内利仍从杆位出发并取得统治性胜利。安东内利看起来无疑是一位蓄势待发的冠军，现在距离他的加冕只剩下最后的冲刺。
更令人印象深刻的是，安东内利相比去年取得了巨大进步，去年他经历了起伏不定的新秀赛季，其中赛季中期那段艰难的欧洲征程尤为突出。
例如在赞德沃特，他在一练中犯下一次不必要的冲出赛道，随后又因在三号弯撞上勒克莱尔被罚时10秒，最终完赛跌出积分区。没有理由认为他这次还会陷入挣扎。
伊斯克·哈贾尔，红牛车队；利亚姆·劳森，小红牛
一直以来对安东内利评价很高的一位车手，就是四届世界冠军维斯塔潘，而这个周末他在红牛又将迎来一次队友更换。只不过这次与表现无关，因为伊萨克·哈贾尔在健身房训练时手腕受伤。
这位21岁的车手没有通过赞德沃特站的体检，而赞德沃特正是他唯一一次登上F1领奖台的地方，因此将由小红牛车手利亚姆·劳森顶替出战。这位新西兰车手将迎来他在红牛的第三场大奖赛——2025年初，由于他在首个完整F1赛季开局表现糟糕，车队早早将他降级。
不过这一次他更加成熟了，这位新西兰车手目前排在积分榜第九位，是四大车队之后的“最强其他人”。他在小红牛与新人阿维德·林德布拉德并肩的位置，将由替补车手角田裕毅接替。角田曾接替劳森在红牛的位置，结果在赛季末又被哈贾尔取代。
对红牛来说，2026年并不算太美好：车队在积分榜上排名第四，落后第三名的迈凯伦43分。但维斯塔潘在过去两场比赛——斯帕和布达佩斯——都登上了领奖台，而哈贾尔在这两站都获得了第六名。
因此，这是劳森（Lawson）证明自己、真正留下印记的机会，表明他从去年在那里艰难的时光中成功反弹。进入第三节排位赛（Q3）并拿到可观的积分，对这位2023年在赞德沃特完成一级方程式首秀的新西兰车手来说，应该算是一个不错的周末。
至于角田裕毅（Tsunoda），考虑到他对2026年赛车的经验有限，这或许是一个更艰巨的任务，但他将驾驶的是一辆小红牛（小红牛）赛车，而小红牛在过去七轮比赛中稳定地领先于中游车队并不断拿到积分。
这个周末，维斯塔潘不仅会迎来一位新队友，这也将是他在可预见的未来里的最后一场主场比赛，因为赞德沃特将从2027年起退出赛历。这是一个相当令人失望的时刻，因为荷兰大奖赛自2021年结束长达36年的中断、重返一级方程式以来，为这项运动贡献了很多。
其中最显著的，就是给一级方程式的明星车手提供了一场主场比赛。荷兰重返锦标赛在很大程度上是因为维斯塔潘，而他也不遗余力地回报了这份情谊——在过去五年中创纪录地三次赢得荷兰大奖赛。
但由于迈凯伦由兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里共同主导的统治，他在最近两场比赛中都未能夺冠；考虑到沃金车队、梅赛德斯和法拉利所占据的优势，他周日也不太可能终结这场不胜纪录。
维斯塔潘仍将佩戴一款特制头盔，以纪念赞德沃特的最后一站比赛。该赛道出于包括财务在内的多种原因，已于2024年底宣布退出。取而代之的是，这条荷兰海滨赛道将出现在电动方程式的赛历上，并在2026-27赛季迎来前景光明的第四代赛车（Gen4）时代。
你听说阿斯顿·马丁本赛季开局艰难了吗？自从车队迟到参加冬季测试以来，这件事已经被提及、讨论和分析过整整一万五千次了。
不过现在情况正在改变，夏休前在匈牙利进行的多项空气动力学升级展现出了潜力。接下来试图扭转车队局面的，是一套来自本田的引擎升级。
对这家日本汽车制造商来说，这关键的一步将在本周末的赞德沃特迈出，本田将在那里部署一次内燃机升级，应当能提升性能和可驾性。据本田总工程师折原晋太郎表示，新部件的目标是帮助阿斯顿·马丁重新回到“比赛阵营”中。
AMR26需要一次动力提升才能追上中游集团的尾部，一些估计认为新部件在赞德沃特可为赛车带来多达30马力的提升。当然，荷兰这条赛道并不是F1赛历上对动力最敏感的赛道，但结合车队推出的其他升级，发动机的提升或许能帮助阿斯顿·马丁摆脱同为垫底者的凯迪拉克。
此外，在荷兰的这个周末用于熟悉新动力单元，将为这支挣扎中的车队提供宝贵经验，供几周后带到速度圣殿蒙扎使用。对于阿隆索、斯特罗尔以及阿斯顿车队的其他成员来说，隧道尽头也许终于出现了光亮。
马尔钦·布德科夫斯基在突发的调整后开始担任凯迪拉克车队领队
当F1围场从夏休期回归时，将迎来一位新的、却又熟悉的面孔——马尔钦·布德科夫斯基将在赞德沃特迎来他作为凯迪拉克车队领队的第一个比赛周末。
格雷姆·劳登受命从零开始打造凯迪拉克。这确实是字面意义上的从零开始，因为他负责监督了这支新F1车队设施的建设以及关键人员的招募，其中包括两位车手——塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯和瓦尔特利·博塔斯。
这是一项在极短时间内完成的庞大任务——尤其以当今F1车队的标准和规模来看更是如此——而凯迪拉克作为第11支车队加入发车区后，首秀表现稳健。在被超越之前，它一直轻松领先于老牌车队阿斯顿·马丁，直到后者在上一站匈牙利站终于推出了重大升级套件。
然而，凯迪拉克F1首席执行官丹·托里斯认为劳登的任期已经走到了尽头，并且如他后来所解释的，单方面决定由布德科夫斯基来执掌这支车队。
这位接受法式教育的波兰人拥有数十年的经验并担任过领导职务，曾效力于法拉利、迈凯伦和阿尔派等车队，还曾在国际汽联（FIA）的一级方程式技术部门任职。
他现在面临的任务是将凯迪拉克推进到项目的下一阶段：成为真正具备中游竞争力的车队，而车队管理层似乎急于尽可能缩短这一过程。
detailEn: Five things to look out for at the F1 Dutch GP
F1 returns from the summer shutdown this weekend with its race at Zandvoort
This weekend’s Dutch Grand Prix marks the return of Formula 1 from its 2026 summer shutdown with the end of the season now firmly in sight.
Zandvoort represents the halfway point of the campaign with championships being decided, legacies made and grid seats for the following season being won or lost post-shutdown.
So there’s plenty to look forward to this weekend and here are five things to watch out for.

There is seemingly nothing stopping the 19-year-old Kimi Antonelli from becoming the youngest ever F1 world champion in 2026. The Mercedes driver holds a 50-point advantage over second-placed Lewis Hamilton and never has a championship leader squandered such a large buffer after the summer break.

It’s certainly not what was expected pre-season, with Antonelli’s team-mate George Russell entering the campaign as the heavy title favourite, but since round two in China, the Italian has been a cut above.
Key to Antonelli’s form has been his one-lap pace, with six poles this season and every time the championship sophomore has suffered a setback, he has bounced back in a champion-like manner.

Think Belgium where he dominated from pole, despite failing to score in two of the prior three rounds - Barcelona and Silverstone - due to reliability woes. Antonelli is certainly looking like a champion-in-waiting and now is just the final stretch before his coronation.
What makes it even more impressive is that Antonelli has made huge strides from last year, when he endured an up-and-down rookie campaign, highlighted by that tough European run mid-season.

In Zandvoort, for example, he made a needless off in FP1 before finishing the race outside of the points after a 10s penalty for colliding into Charles Leclerc at Turn 3. There is no reason to think he’ll struggle this time around.
Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing, Liam Lawson, Racing Bulls

One driver who has always spoken highly of Antonelli is four-time world champion Max Verstappen, who this weekend will have yet another team-mate change at Red Bull. Only this time it isn’t performance related, as Isack Hadjar injured his wrist during a gym session.

The 21-year-old hasn’t passed fit for Zandvoort, the sight of his only F1 podium, so will be replaced by Racing Bulls man Liam Lawson. The Kiwi is set for his third grand prix at Red Bull after being demoted by the team early in 2025 following a very poor start to his first full season in F1.

He’s more mature this time though, as the New Zealander is ninth in the standings and ‘best of the rest’ behind the top four teams. His spot alongside rookie Arvid Lindblad at Racing Bulls will be taken by reserve driver Yuki Tsunoda, who took Lawson’s spot at Red Bull, only to be dropped for Hadjar at the end of the season.

It’s not exactly been the most amazing 2026 for Red Bull, which is fourth in the standings and 43 points behind third-placed McLaren, but Verstappen has scored a podium in the last two races - Spa and Budapest - while Hadjar finished sixth in both.

So, there is the opportunity for Lawson to impress and really make his mark as somebody who has bounced back from his torrid time there last year. A Q3 appearance and solid points haul should mark a good weekend for the New Zealander, who made his F1 debut at Zandvoort in 2023.

As for Tsunoda, it’s perhaps a tougher ask considering his little experience with the 2026 machines but he is stepping into a Racing Bulls car that comfortably leads the midfield with points in the last seven rounds.

Not only will Verstappen have a new team-mate this weekend, but it will also be his final home race for the indefinite future as Zandvoort is dropping off the calendar for 2027. It’s quite a disappointing moment because the Dutch Grand Prix has offered a lot to F1 since it ended its 36-year hiatus by returning in 2021.

Most notably, giving F1’s star driver a home race. Verstappen was largely the reason for the Netherlands returning to the championship and he has certainly given it his best shot by winning the Dutch GP a record three times in the past five years.

But he has failed to win the last two due to McLaren domination - shared by both Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri - and it is unlikely he’ll end that win-less streak on Sunday due to the advantage held by the Woking outfit, Mercedes and Ferrari.

Verstappen will still sport a special helmet to mark the final race at Zandvoort, which announced its departure at the end of 2024 for various reasons including financial. Instead, the Dutch seaside circuit will feature on the Formula E calendar when it introduces the promising Gen4 era in the 2026-27 campaign.
Did you hear that Aston Martin had a rough start to the season? It’s only been mentioned, discussed and analysed precisely 15,000 times since the team arrived late to winter testing.
Now, though, things are changing and various aerodynamic updates in Hungary before the summer break showed promise. Next up to try and turn the team around is an engine upgrade from Honda.

This vital step for the Japanese automaker will come in Zandvoort this weekend, where Honda will deploy an internal combustion upgrade that should aid performance and driveability. The target for the new parts is to help Aston Martin move back up towards the “racing field”, according to Honda chief engineer Shintaro Orihara.

The AMR26 needs a power boost to catch the back of the midfield, and some estimates suggest the new parts could bring as much as 30bhp to the car around Zandvoort. Now, the Dutch track isn’t the most power-sensitive circuit on the F1 calendar, but coupled with the other updates the team has rolled out, an engine boost could help Aston move clear of fellow backmarker Cadillac.

What’s more, a weekend to get to grips with the new unit in the Netherlands will offer vital learnings that the struggling team can take to Monza, the temple of speed, in a few weeks’ time. Maybe there finally is light at the end of the tunnel for Fernando Alonso, Lance Stroll and the rest of the Aston team.
Marcin Budkowski begins life as Cadillac team principal after abrupt shakeup
F1's paddock will welcome a new - yet familiar - face when it returns from the summer break, with Marcin Budkowski taking on his first race weekend as Cadillac's team principal at Zandvoort.

Graeme Lowdon was tasked with building Cadillac from the ground up. And that is meant literally, as he oversaw the construction of the new F1 team's facilities and the recruitment of key personnel, including its two drivers, Sergio Perez and Valtteri Bottas.

It was a mammoth task completed in a remarkably short timeframe – particularly by the standards and scale of today's F1 teams – and Cadillac has since enjoyed a solid debut on the grid as the 11th team. It comfortably stayed ahead of established outfit Aston Martin until the latter finally introduced a major upgrade package at the previous round in Hungary.
However, Cadillac F1 CEO Dan Towriss decided that Lowdon's tenure had run its course and, as he later explained, made the unilateral decision to put Budkowski in charge of the outfit.
The French-educated Pole brings decades of experience and leadership roles, having worked with teams including Ferrari, McLaren and Alpine, as well as serving in the FIA's F1 technical department.
He now faces the task of taking Cadillac into the next phase of its project: becoming a genuine midfield contender, a process the outfit's management appears keen to make as short as possible.

detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.

detailZh: 丹尼尔·里卡多在美国大奖赛前夕的现场表演令F1粉丝感到惊喜
前F1车手丹尼尔·里卡多与音乐家罗布·贝尔德一起吹奏口琴，令粉丝感到惊喜
丹尼尔·里卡多，Drive to Survive第七季
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
前一级方程式车手丹尼尔·里卡多在美国德克萨斯州奥斯汀的舞台上出现了一个惊喜。
这位澳大利亚人与歌手兼词曲作者罗布·贝尔德一起加入了福特赛车和Enchanté快闪活动，在周五晚上一起演奏他与美国大奖赛旅途中共创作的原创歌曲。
一位粉丝在Instagram上发布的表演视频，截至写作时已经获得了超过7000个赞。一位粉丝评论说：“这治愈了我心中的某一部分，”另一位粉丝补充说：“我敢打赌他上辈子要么是鲍勃·迪伦的兄弟，要么是个牛仔哈哈。我们爱你，丹尼尔。”
“在这个时候，没有人关心比赛。很高兴看到丹尼尔回来了，即使他不再赛车，”另一位粉丝写道，另一位粉丝写道：“作为一个音乐家和蜜獾粉丝，和丹尼·里卡多一起演奏是我的梦想。”
“我是说真的很长的一段路。沙漠、乡村小道、游泳洞，所有这些。说实话，我迫不及待了。”
这次长途旅行是推广新系列 Enchanté Collection 的活动之一，名为《长途》。这些新产品在奥斯汀的 Distribution Hall 的临时展位上出售，展位上还有食品、饮料、闪粉纹身和赛车模拟器。
里卡多也被看到在支持 小红牛 车队的车手利亚姆·劳森，作为新西兰人，他在 Esses Bazaar ATX 活动中担任主角，与利亚姆·劳森和朋友们一起在东第六街的 Inn Cahoots 举办车库音乐会，此次活动是为本周末的美国大奖赛做准备。
detailEn: Daniel Ricciardo surprises F1 fans with on-stage performance ahead of US GP
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo surprised fans with a harmonica performance alongside musician Rob Baird
Daniel Ricciardo , Drive to Survive Season 7
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo made a surprise appearance on stage in Austin, Texas, with American singer-songwriter Rob Baird.
The Australian joined Baird at the Ford Racing and Enchanté pop-up on Friday night to play harmonica on an original song he co-wrote with Baird during a road trip to the United States Grand Prix.

A fan video of the performance, posted on Instagram, had picked up more than 7000 likes by the time of writing. "This healed something in me," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm sure he was either Bob Dylan's brother or a cowboy in a previous life lol. We love you, Daniel."

"At this point, no one cares about the race. Glad to see Daniel back, even if he’s not racing," someone else posted, and another fan wrote: "As a musician and a honey badger fan, it would be a dream to play with Danny Ric."
"And I mean the lonnnng way. Desert, backroads, swimming holes, all of it. Not gonna lie, I can't wait."

The road trip was part of the promotion of the new Enchanté collection, The Long Road. The new products are being sold at a pop-up at Distribution Hall in Austin alongside food, drinks, flash tattoos and racing simulators.

Ricciardo was also spotted supporting Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson as the New Zealander headlined Garage Sessions with Liam Lawson and Friends as part of Esses Bazaar ATX, held at Inn Cahoots on East Sixth Street ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix.

detailZh: 尼科·胡肯伯格在美国大奖赛上被加布里埃尔·博特洛托恶作剧后颜面扫地
加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美国大奖赛期间的一次粉丝见面会上玩了一个意外的恶作剧，让他的奥迪车队队友笑得前仰后合
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
年轻的奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美洲赛道前与队友尼科·胡肯伯格走在一起时，对他进行了一次恶作剧。两位车手在奥斯汀观众的欢呼声中走出，巴西人拉下了队友的裤子。
这个时刻的视频已经迅速走红，展示了胡肯伯格在周五如何走上舞台，当时博尔特洛从后面抓住他的裤子并将其拉下，引发了观众的欢呼和笑声。这位德国人对此玩笑表示宽容，一边笑着一边整理好衣服。
这个恶作剧为博尔特洛艰难的周末带来了一些轻松。巴西人在周日美国大奖赛将从最后一排发车，因为奥迪为他提供的动力单元组件超出了分配额度。
博尔特洛和胡肯伯格自2025年以来一直是队友，当时车队还以萨博的身份参赛，尽管车队已被德国巨头奥迪接管，但他们成为了赛场上更为轻松的搭档之一。然而，车队在2026年很难获得积分。车队在车队积分榜上排名第八，积分为23分，胡肯伯格积13分，博尔特洛积10分。
博尔特洛在美国大奖赛周末赛前表示：“我在可靠性方面看到了很多改进。显然，我们在新加坡显然有一个问题，我们相信我们已经找到了原因。”
“这显然不是理想的情况，但与此同时，它发生的时候我并没有在前面真正地竞争，所以这让我对它稍微不那么沮丧。但我希望我们能够在接下来的赛季中没有任何重大问题，并且能够以最佳状态完成比赛和排位赛，驾驶我们能够驾驶的最好的汽车，从中提取一切。”
detailEn: Nico Hulkenberg left red-faced after Gabriel Bortoleto prank at United States GP
Gabriel Bortoleto left his Audi team-mate laughing after pulling an unexpected prank during a fan appearance at the United States Grand Prix
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Young Audi driver Gabriel Bortoleto played a prank on his team-mate Nico Hulkenberg as the pair walked out in front of thousands of fans at the Circuit of the Americas. With both drivers walking out to cheers from the Austin crowds, the Brazilian pulled down his team-mate's trousers.

Videos of this moment have gone incredibly viral, showing Hulkenberg making his way onto the stage on Friday when Bortoleto grabbed his trousers from behind and pulled them down, to loud cheers and laughter from the crowd. The German took the joke in good humour, laughing as he pulled his clothes straight.

The prank offered some light relief on a tough weekend for Bortoleto. The Brazilian will start Sunday’s United States Grand Prix from the back of the grid, after Audi took him beyond his allocation of power unit components.

Bortoleto and Hulkenberg have been team-mates since 2025, when the team still raced as Sauber, and have formed one of the more light-hearted partnerships on the grid despite it being taken over by German giant Audi. The outfit has found points hard to come by in 2026, however. The team is eighth in the constructors’ championship on 23 points, with the experienced Hulkenberg on 13 and Bortoleto on 10.

"I have seen lots of improvement on reliability," Bortoleto said on Thursday ahead of the United States Grand Prix race weekend. "I think we had one [issue] in Singapore obviously, that we believe we found the reason of.

"It was obviously something not ideal to happen, but at the same time it happened when I was not really fighting at the front, so made me a little bit less upset about it. But I hope we are able to do the rest of the season without having any major issue and that we are able to just complete the races and qualifying in the best condition and the best car possible out there that we can drive and extract everything from it."
